turns.assistant_text:
The article "Attention Is All You Need" by Adnan Masood, PhD, explains the significance of the 2017 paper by Vaswani et al. from Google Brain/Google Research, which introduced the Transformer model. Here are the key points:

1. **Transformer Model**: The Transformer is a sequence-to-sequence architecture built entirely on self-attention, eliminating the need for recurrence and convolutions.

2. **Self-Attention**: This concept allows the model to read a whole sentence at once and lets each word decide which other words are important, facilitating faster training.

3. **Parallelizable Training**: The architecture makes learning long-range dependencies easier and enables training to be more parallelizable, reducing costs.

4. **Impact on NLP**: The Transformer achieved state-of-the-art translation quality and has become the foundational design for modern large language models and much of today's NLP stack.

For more details, you can read the full article on [Medium](https://medium.com/@adnanmasood/attention-is-all-you-need-explained-like-youre-smart-and-busy-2a3d7436144f).

items.summary: Medium Attention Is All You Need, explained like you’re smart and busy | by Adnan Masood, PhD. | Medium Sitemap Open in app Sign up Sign in Get app Write Search Sign up Sign in Member-only story Attention Is All You Need, explained like you’re smart and busy How a simple idea — self-attention — replaced recurrence, unlocked parallelism, and reshaped modern language models Adnan Masood, PhD. 18 min read · Jan 13, 2026 -- Listen Share “ Attention Is All You Need ” (Vaswani, Shazeer, Parmar, Uszkoreit, Jones, Gomez, Kaiser, and Polosukhin) is the 2017 NeurIPS paper from Google Brain/Google Research that introduced the Transformer , a sequence-to-sequence architecture built entirely on attention , eliminating recurrence and convolutions. Its significance is hard to overstate: by making long-range dependencies easier to learn and training far more parallelizable , it delivered state-of-the-art translation quality with dramatically lower training cost, and it became the foundational design behind modern large language models and much of today’s NLP stack. Press enter or click to view image in full size If you take nothing else away, take this: A Transformer is a model that reads a whole sentence at once and lets each word decide which other words matter to it. That “deciding who matters” is attention . And the “at once” part is why it trains fast.
